Table 1 lists the standard single-qubit gates used in the compiler.

\begin{table}[h]\centering
\begin{tabular}{lll}
\toprule
Gate & Matrix & Cost \\
\midrule
Pauli-X & $\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$ & 1 \\[8pt]
Pauli-Z & $\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&-1\end{pmatrix}$ & 1 \\[8pt]
Hadamard & $\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$ & 2 \\[8pt]
Phase & $\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&i\end{pmatrix}$ & 1 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
After the table the text continues with an ordinary paragraph of prose.
